description: Deep within the historic Hall of Thanes, an ethereal attendant pleads for an end to the torment of a fallen ruler. The spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar lingers…
intro: Deep within the historic Hall of Thanes, an ethereal attendant pleads for an end to the torment of a fallen ruler. The spirit of Faldrim Anvilmar lingers on, consumed by an old grievance and denied eternal peace. Adventurers are tasked with putting the restless thane to rest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The... Thane... My mighty... Thane... He... Needs to... Rest.
Please... Help him... Help him... Rest...
Consumed... By... Ancient... Grudge... No... Rest...

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
